employerPricing.lead: Post your offer for free and see who applies. You only pay when you want to talk to the applicants.

1.title: Post for free
1.text: Your offer is listed in the search for 30 days.

2.title: See the applicants
2.text: Trade, experience, TPC card, safety training and area of everyone who applies.

3.title: Unlock the chat
3.text: With the offer activated, you see their phone and email and can write to them.

1.q: What can I see without paying?
1.a: How many people applied and each one's profile: trade, years of experience, safety training, TPC card, driving licence and area. Full name, phone, email and the chat unlock when you activate the offer.

2.a: No. Every payment is one-off: an offer activated for 30 days, a 30-day plan or a pack of contacts. Nothing renews by itself.

3.a: They let you write to workers in the directory who haven't applied to your offer. Each new worker you contact uses one; writing to them again costs nothing.

4.q: What if the worker doesn't reply?
4.a: The chat stays open with every applicant of the offer while the activation lasts, and the conversation is kept afterwards.
